title: Lab 4C — Step Functions capstone
topic: Step Functions Standard vs Express, ECS runTask.sync, SQS/Lambda/SNS service integrations, Retry/Catch, iam:PassRole, GSA Iceland pipeline orchestration, migration from EventBridge chain
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-32-stepfunctions-capstone.md and gsa-stepfunctions-map.md. Answer without peeking at night-32-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas needs a monthly workflow: run Iceland Fargate for up to two hours, enqueue completion to SQS, invoke a stats Lambda, and route failures to SNS with different retry counts per step. Which service is the best orchestration fit?

options.A: Step Functions Standard workflow with per-step Retry, Catch, and sync integrations
options.B: EventBridge schedule using five separate rules with no shared execution history
options.C: SQS FIFO queue with a single consumer handling every pipeline stage inline
options.D: Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream writing each stage output straight to S3

questions.question: The capstone uses `arn:aws:states:::ecs:runTask.sync` for Iceland. What does the `.sync` suffix mean for the state machine?

options.A: ECS pushes a callback token as soon as the container process starts running
options.B: Step Functions waits until the ECS task reaches STOPPED before advancing
options.C: The Fargate task runs synchronously inside the Lambda execution environment
options.D: EventBridge forwards ECS state-change events without the workflow waiting

questions.question: A Step Functions `RunTask` state fails with `ECS.AmazonECSException` after two retries. The ASL has a `Catch` to `PublishFailureAlert` (SNS). What happens next?

options.A: The execution ends successfully because the Retry block already completed
options.B: SQS automatically moves an unseen message into the configured dead-letter queue
options.C: The Catch state runs and publishes a failure alert to the Night 14 SNS topic
options.D: EventBridge disables the monthly schedule rule after the second failed retry

questions.question: Night 32 deploys a new EventBridge rule `saa-study-gsa-iceland-monthly-sfn` targeting the state machine. The legacy `saa-study-gsa-iceland-monthly` rule still targets ECS directly. What is the operational risk?

options.A: SNS topic subscriptions for Iceland alerts are deleted without warning
options.B: Step Functions Express execution history is truncated after five minutes
options.C: SQS FIFO message ordering for wiki traffic is violated by the new rule
options.D: Two Iceland Fargate tasks may start on the same monthly schedule window

questions.question: Which IAM permission must the Step Functions execution role have for `ecs:RunTask` on the Iceland task definition?

options.A: iam:PassRole for the ECS execution role and the task role used by RunTask
options.B: s3:PutObject on the pipeline output bucket as the only required permission
options.C: lambda:InvokeFunction on the stats uploader without any PassRole grants
options.D: events:PutTargets on the legacy monthly rule to replace the ECS target

questions.question: An exam scenario needs sub-minute fan-out of thousands of short payment authorizations with optional discarded execution history. Which Step Functions type fits?

options.A: Standard — retain a full durable audit trail for every authorization attempt
options.B: Express — high volume, short duration, lower per-execution overhead
options.C: Standard with `.waitForTaskToken` blocking on every authorization step
options.D: SQS standard queue alone with no workflow orchestration service involved

questions.question: After `RunIcelandTask` succeeds, the capstone sends a message to `saa-study-gsa-iceland-completion` via `sqs:sendMessage`. Why keep SQS instead of only synchronous Lambda invoke?

options.A: SQS is mandatory because Step Functions cannot invoke Lambda Task states
options.B: SNS fan-out is always slower than SQS for every completion notification path
options.C: Durable buffer plus the existing Night 17 event source mapping / replay path
options.D: SQS is the only service that can express monthly cron schedules for Iceland

questions.question: In the Night 32 ASL, `InvokeStatsUploader` has Retry on `Lambda.ServiceException` but Catch on `States.ALL` to SNS. Lambda returns a handled error in the payload with HTTP 200. What happens?

options.A: Catch runs immediately because the function returned a JSON error object
options.B: Retry runs because Lambda.ServiceException was not thrown by the runtime
options.C: The execution pauses until an SQS DLQ redrive restarts the Task state
options.D: The Task state succeeds and the workflow continues toward PublishSuccess

questions.question: How does AWS primarily bill Step Functions Standard workflows?

options.A: Per state transition (with duration charges for some long-running integrations)
options.B: Per ECS cluster hour regardless of how many state machine executions run
options.C: Per SNS email delivery only when a Publish state appears in the ASL
options.D: Flat monthly fee per state machine definition regardless of transition count

questions.question: Night 28 used EventBridge `saa-study-gsa-iceland-success-to-sqs` on ECS Task State Change. Night 32 Step Functions also `sendMessage`s to the same queue. What should you do to avoid duplicate completion messages?

options.A: Delete the SQS queue and recreate it with a new name and empty backlog
options.B: Disable the legacy success EventBridge rule or remove its target when SFN owns enqueue
options.C: Switch the queue to FIFO and rely only on content-based deduplication
options.D: Replace the SNS failure topic with Kinesis Data Streams for completion events

questions.question: A human approval gate is required mid-workflow before publishing ski stats to production Aurora. Which Step Functions pattern applies?

options.A: Express workflow that only runs `ecs:runTask` without waiting for operators
options.B: SQS long polling configured directly inside the state machine definition JSON
options.C: Task state with `.waitForTaskToken` until an operator calls `SendTaskSuccess`
options.D: CloudWatch alarm action on FailedInvocations used as the approval signal

questions.question: The Iceland container exits with code 1 after starting. With `runTask.sync`, how should the capstone surface failure to operators?

options.A: CloudWatch FailedInvocations on the schedule rule — the container already ran
options.B: SQS redrive policy alone sends email without any Catch configuration
options.C: Step Functions Express discards the error and marks the execution succeeded
options.D: The RunTask state fails; Catch routes the failure to an SNS publish state

questions.question: Which integration ARN publishes a success notification to the existing `saa-study-gsa-iceland-alerts` topic at the end of a happy path?

options.A: arn:aws:states:::sns:publish for the PublishSuccess notification state
options.B: arn:aws:states:::sqs:sendMessage for the completion queue enqueue step
options.C: arn:aws:states:::ecs:runTask for starting the Iceland Fargate container
options.D: arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents for writing a custom EventBridge bus event

questions.question: Why is Step Functions Standard (not Express) correct for the Iceland capstone?

options.A: Express workflows cannot integrate with SNS publish Task states at all
options.B: Express max duration is five minutes — Iceland may run about two hours
options.C: Standard workflows cannot define Catch blocks for failed Task states
options.D: Express requires a FIFO SQS queue as the mandatory first state in ASL

questions.question: A teammate suggests replacing the entire Night 32 state machine with a single EventBridge cron → `ecs:RunTask` like Night 12. What capability would they lose?

options.A: Ability to place Fargate tasks in private subnets with no public IP
options.B: Permission to write pipeline GeoParquet output objects into the S3 bucket
options.C: Per-step Retry/Catch, sync wait for STOPPED, and a visible multi-step graph
options.D: Use of IAM task and execution roles on the ECS Fargate task definition
